links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses to post-kidney-transplant patient questions (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: Median Flesch Reading Ease 22.1 [8.7,34.8]; median Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 14.7 [12.3,16.7], akin to undergraduate-level text; readability challenging.
